prompt: create a new webapp that connects to a sql lite database and retrieve a string 'hello world' and display it on the web app. Make it look visually stunning.

members.name: project-scaffolder
members.purpose: Creates the webapp project skeleton: directory layout, package.json/deps (Express or Flask), run scripts, README, and agreed contract file (API route GET /api/message returning {"message": "hello world"}, port, static asset paths) that all other agents build against.

members.name: sqlite-data-agent
members.purpose: Creates the SQLite database file plus an idempotent init/seed script that creates a messages table and inserts the row 'hello world'; exposes a small data-access module with a getMessage() function.

members.name: backend-api-agent
members.purpose: Implements the web server that opens the SQLite DB via the data-access module, serves GET /api/message with the retrieved string, serves the static frontend, and handles errors/empty-DB cases gracefully.

members.name: frontend-ui-agent
members.purpose: Builds the HTML/JS front end that fetches /api/message on load and renders the returned string, with loading and error states and semantic, accessible markup.

members.name: visual-design-agent
members.purpose: Delivers the 'visually stunning' layer: modern CSS (gradient/glassmorphism hero, custom fonts, animated entrance, responsive layout, dark-mode support) styling the hooks/classes defined by the frontend agent.

members.name: integration-verifier
members.purpose: Installs deps, runs the seed script, boots the server, curls /api/message, loads the page to confirm 'hello world' renders with styling applied, checks console/server errors, and reports or fixes final wiring issues.

team.plan: Step 1: project-scaffolder runs alone to fix the stack, file layout, and the API/DOM contract. Step 2 (parallel): sqlite-data-agent, backend-api-agent, frontend-ui-agent, and visual-design-agent all work simultaneously against that contract — DB+seed, server+route, markup+fetch logic, and stylesheet are independent files. Step 3: integration-verifier runs last, end-to-end, after all four merge.
